That evening, he watched the sunset himself, more carefully than he had in years.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市陷入最深沉的寂静。路灯将橘黄的光芒洒在空旷的街道上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水发出细碎的声响。清洁工推着手推车缓缓前行，扫帚划过地面的沙沙声是这座城市最温柔的呼吸。远处，早餐铺的灯亮了，热气从半开的门缝中溢出，带着油条和豆浆的香味。天际线还沉在墨蓝色里，但东方已经隐隐泛起一丝微光。这座城市尚未醒来，却已在梦中翻了一个身。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a point where it stops calling itself and just gives a simple answer, like finally finding a word you already know.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and someone asks the last person \"how many people are in this line?\" — each person asks the one in front, until the first person says \"one,\" and then each person adds one and passes the answer back."}
